chunks.title: Set up SDK — LedgeIndex Docs

chunks.text:
## [API](https://ledgeindex.com/guides/setup-sdk#api)


### [createLedgeIndex(options?)](https://ledgeindex.com/guides/setup-sdk#createledgeindexoptions)
Initializes Mastra, storage, and vector backends once per process. Returns a `LedgeIndex` handle.

Option

Default

Purpose

`dataDir`

`~/.ledgeindex/data`

Sources, LibSQL vectors, workflow state

`localUserId`

`ledgeindex-sdk-local`

Owner id for personal sources

`keys`

env vars

`openai`, `google`, `deepseek`, `cohere`

`provider`

auto

Force `google` | `openai` | `deepseek`

`vectorBackend`

`libsql`

`libsql` (FastEmbed) or `pgvector` (Gemini)

`postgresUrl`

—

Required for `pgvector`

`rerankBackend`

cohere if key else local

Override rerank on `ask`
chunks.title: Set up SDK — LedgeIndex Docs

chunks.text:
## [Setup paths](https://ledgeindex.com/guides#setup-paths)
Work through these in order if you are new. Each guide is self-contained.

### [Package guides](https://ledgeindex.com/guides#package-guides)
No server required for CLI/SDK. Repository indexing uses the SDK scripts or in-process API.

Guide

What you get

[Set up CLI](/guides/setup-cli)

Terminal crawl, ask, profile — `~/.ledgeindex/data`

[Set up SDK](/guides/setup-sdk)

`createLedgeIndex()`, `crawl`, `ask`, `askAcross`, `indexRepo` in Node

[Index documentation](/guides/setup-docs)

Docs site crawl → persistent index → URL citations

[Index a repository](/guides/setup-repo)

GitHub repo → persistent index → file:line citations

### [Self-host](https://ledgeindex.com/guides#self-host)
Run the API (and usually the web UI) when you want a browser, Docker, desktop app, or MCP.

Guide

What you get

[Set up website widget](/guides/setup-widget)

Embed Ask AI on your site (public `websiteId` + origins)

[Set up web](/guides/setup-web)

API `:3010` + Next.js `:3004` + MCP `/mcp`

[Set up Docker](/guides/setup-docker)

Compose — LibSQL or Postgres + Gemini

[Set up desktop](/guides/setup-desktop)

Electron app, sidecar `:3015`

[Set up MCP](/guides/setup-mcp)

Cursor / Claude Desktop on your index (needs API)

### [Library & custom host](https://ledgeindex.com/guides#library--custom-host)
Install `@ledgeindex/*`, call `startLedgeIndexServer`, or compose core primitives yourself.

→ [Self-host the API](/docs/getting-started)
